products.name: Monitaur
products.note: Model monitoring with built-in governance; unified monitoring + governance platform

profile_text.body:
Monitaur is an AI governance software company that describes itself as providing "actionable governance for the entire lifecycle of AI." Its platform is aimed at enterprise customers, particularly in financial services and insurance, and is designed to help organizations establish company-wide standards and controls, continuously monitor model performance, and validate AI models with consistent protocols and transparent reporting. The company positions its software as enabling compliance with complex regulations while also supporting ongoing AI development and adoption.

The core product, also called Monitaur, is categorized as an AI Governance and Risk Management Platform. It combines model monitoring with built-in governance and offers features the company describes as covering policy development, model validation, and third-party AI risk management. Specific capabilities mentioned on the site include Common Controls and FlightSim, the latter described in the context of addressing gaps left by SR 26-2, a regulatory guidance the company says excludes generative and agentic AI from model risk management scope. The site references case studies involving a leading insurance provider, an enterprise insurer governing third-party AI projects, and a Fortune 200 financial services and insurance company, though none are named.

Monitaur's site notes a placement in Gartner's inaugural Magic Quadrant for AI Governance as a Visionary, which the company has published commentary on. No litigation, SEC filings, MCP server registrations, or patent facts are present in the held data.
